label: Task
depicts: Clipboard panel with one top clip and one large check mark in the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants the task cue to read as a completed clipboard item with a check mark.
avoid_when: Do not use for the list clipboard when the panel should show horizontal task lines instead of one big check mark.

label: Task
depicts: Clipboard panel with one top clip and three horizontal list bars down the center
use_when: Use when the interface wants the task cue to read as a list of items on a clipboard.
avoid_when: Do not use for the checked clipboard when the panel should not be dominated by one large check mark.

label: Telescope
depicts: Long telescope body tilted on one tripod stand with the eyepiece pointing toward the upper right
use_when: Use when the interface wants an observing scope mounted on a stand rather than a handheld viewing tool.
avoid_when: Do not use for the binoculars when the viewing tool should split into two barrels with two eyepieces.

label: Telescope
depicts: Pair of binocular barrels joined at the center with two round eyepieces at the lower ends
use_when: Use when the interface wants a dual barrel handheld viewing tool instead of a mounted telescope.
avoid_when: Do not use for the tripod telescope when the sighting tool should not be one long angled tube on a stand.

label: Disapproval
depicts: Thumb silhouette pointing downward with one rounded back and one short cuff nub on the left
use_when: Use when the interface wants a compact rounded thumbs down shape without a long separate wrist block.
avoid_when: Do not use for the more structured thumbs down hand when the wrist and palm should look more segmented.
